title: A new view of Skying
question: The Light Finder brings the sunset decision into focus. Choose this direction, request a different approach, or use the familiar weather-app layout.

options.label: The Light Finder
options.lineage: Precision camera viewfinders and outdoor light meters
options.thesis: See whether to head out, through one panoramic window onto the evening.
options.viewport: A wide sky window, prominent sunset verdict, viewing time, and a continuous seven-day strip.
options.risk: Instrument details must stay quiet enough for everyday visitors.

raised.raise: Conditions collapse by task priority at each breakpoint.
The verdict owns a decisive typographic scale.
Secondary data recedes while the next action remains still.
Every search and loading state gives explicit feedback.
Selected days use unmistakable, consistent contrast.
The sky stays the visual subject rather than generic dashboard chrome.
